```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Import data

```{r import-data}
dat <- read_csv("data/raw/synthetic_data.csv")
```

# Initial Data Exploration

## Dataset dimensions

```{r}
dim(dat)
```

## Variable names

```{r}
names(dat)
```

## Variable structure

```{r}
str(dat)
```

# Basic Distributions

## Records and individuals

```{r records-individuals}
# Total number of records
nrow(dat)

# Number of unique individuals
dplyr::n_distinct(dat$id_persona)

# Number of records per individual
table(table(dat$id_persona))
```

## Age at case creation

```{r age-summary}
# Number with non-missing age
sum(!is.na(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso))

# Number missing age
sum(is.na(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso))

# Basic distribution
summary(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso)

# Standard deviation
sd(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso, na.rm = TRUE)

# Range
range(dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r age-histogram}
hist(
  dat$edad_ano_creacion_caso,
  main = "Distribution of Age at Case Creation",
  xlab = "Age (years)"
)
```

## Chilean/foreign status

```{r nationality-status}
# Counts
table(dat$cmd_cond_chile_extranj, useNA = "ifany")

# Percentages
round(
  prop.table(table(dat$cmd_cond_chile_extranj, useNA = "ifany")) * 100,
  1
)
```

## Sex

```{r sex}

round(
```

## Region

```{r region}
# Counts by region
table(dat$cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef, useNA = "ifany")

# Percentage by region
round(
  prop.table(table(dat$cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef, useNA = "ifany")) * 100,
  1
)
```

```{r region-plot}
barplot(
  table(dat$cmd_cod_deis_regi_benef),
  main = "Number of Records by Region",
  xlab = "Region code",
  ylab = "Number of records"
)
```
